common.purpose: Decide the assertion story for near-captured database pools, the file layout of the four example programs, and the test boundary for every P13 outcome in the Can admission suite.
fixed_constraints: Native-ai, account-search, form-validation, and dashboard each arrive as a manifest-backed project with can.project.json, can.errors.json, src/, a README, and strictly declared assets and dependencies, building fresh and running end-to-end from staged layouts with genuine Can assertions.

P13 pins the account-search shape: ordinary records, four named mounted callbacks, a single open sql::pool captured via near, one static descriptor, and eleven outcome rows; fragments plus harness behavior are explicitly not complete programs.

Mandatory assertions bind row arguments to non-elided inputs positionally; the checker elides http::request and sql::transaction to a harness token but not sql::pool, and since no expression yields a pool, pool-taking functions are unassertable as the checker stands.

Raw staged HTTP sees statuses, headers, and bodies; HTMX swap versus no-swap is visible solely in the pinned browser; raw-provider and supplied evidence carry separate labels; shipped verdicts never rest on live provider calls.

pool_assertion_inputs.background: Near-captured pools reach the production loader and the search callback as assertable inputs the assertion language cannot value, so the P13-mandated assertions for those functions cannot be written today.
facts: A pool elision would hand rows the identical frozen harness token already served for all elided positions, and pool operations lacking a when supply die at the assertion live-boundary denial.
Current fixtures never declare pool inputs because each query function opens its pool in its body, hence elision widens acceptance without altering any recorded pass or fail.
Per-request open and close inside callbacks avoids checker work yet breaks the capture contract and repeats connection setup on every request the server fields.

app_source_layout.background: The largest application covers records, model mapping, page and fragment rendering, four mounted callbacks, routing, boot, and the serving main; its siblings repeat the pattern at smaller scale.
facts: A single src/main.can holds each application near four hundred lines maximum, reviewable in one pass with zero inter-file linkage to maintain.
Module splits across src/ route through provides and uses like production code, exercising resolution, overlays, and jumps across files in every admission run.
Fresh builds, true assertions, and documented end-to-end runs gate both shapes identically; the choice trades review locality against project realism.

negative_allocation.background: Validation, SQL mapping, routing, rendering, and shutdown rows in the outcome table surface through different channels that no single harness observes alone.
facts: Deterministic raw-HTTP staging covers every status, header, body, multiplicity, and limit row cheaply, but stays blind to fragment swapping.
Pinned-browser scenarios witness genuine 200/422 swaps and 404/405/500/503 withholds per row, trading engine fidelity for slower execution.
Localhost-only routing plus per-check records come free with the I34 browser harness for any scenario added beneath it.

pool_assertion_inputs.instructions: Pick the assertion design for near-captured pools. Consult common and topics.pool_assertion_inputs.

criteria.elide_pool: Treat sql::pool inputs as harness-supplied like transaction handles: previously unassertable functions gain assertions, shipped verdicts stay fixed, and live pool use without supply keeps failing closed.
criteria.per_request_open: Open and close pools inside each callback body instead: zero checker delta, at the price of abandoning near capture and paying connection setup per request.
criteria.review_needed: Neither design is separable on this evidence, or neither preserves the contracts.

app_source_layout.instructions: Pick one source layout per application. Consult common and topics.app_source_layout.

criteria.single_file: One src/main.can each: minimal linkage, single-pass review, and fixtures that never demonstrate multi-file structure.
criteria.multi_module: Modules under src/ for records plus model, renderers, callbacks plus routes, and main: realistic linkage and resolution coverage with a wider consistency surface.
criteria.review_needed: Neither layout is separable on this evidence, or neither preserves the contracts.

negative_allocation.instructions: Pick the boundary allocation for outcome rows. Consult common and topics.negative_allocation.

criteria.split_by_observability: Send status, header, and body rows to staged HTTP and swap and no-swap rows to the browser: each outcome is witnessed at the single boundary that can see it.
criteria.http_first: Establish all rows over staged HTTP and reserve the browser for happy-path swaps: full deterministic coverage with error-swap behavior never exercised in an engine.
criteria.review_needed: Neither allocation is separable on this evidence, or neither preserves the contracts.
